label: fairlife
note: Coca-Cola; launched in Minnesota in February 2014, nationally in February 2015; lactase is added, so it is lactose-free

about.text: An American brand of ultra-filtered milk owned by Coca-Cola, sold as whole, reduced-fat, fat-free and flavoured milk. It first appeared in Minnesota in February 2014 and went national in February 2015; it is lactose-free and made without added protein powder.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: 80 % casein, 20 % whey, concentrated from the milk itself
50 % more protein, 50 % less sugar (fairlife's own claim)
Coca-Cola's North America president cited 30 % less sugar in 2015
